from stats import average
assert average([]) == 0
assert average([4]) == 4
assert average([1, 2]) == 1.5
assert average([-3, 3]) == 0
assert average([10, 20, 30, 40]) == 25
assert abs(average([0.1, 0.2]) - 0.15) < 1e-9
print("ok")

note: average returns 0 on empty, correct means on other inputs
